item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q008_v1_atp_synthase_bulge_classification","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, the V1 ATP synthase A-subunit bulge domain is superfamily b.84.5 (SUNID 310577) within the barrel-sandwich-hybrid fold b.84 (SUNID 51229). It shares the fold’s sandwich of half-barrel-shaped beta sheets with b.84.1 (single hybrid motif), b.84.2 (rudiment single hybrid motif), b.84.3 (duplicated hybrid motif), and b.84.4 (ribosomal L27 protein-like), but SCOPe separates it because fold-level architectural similarity is not sufficient evidence of common ancestry. Its placement therefore asserts probable common ancestry within b.84.5—not between b.84.5 and b.84.1–b.84.4. More specifically, family b.84.5.1 (SUNID 310616) groups both V1 and A1 ATP synthase A-subunit bulge domains and makes the stronger family-level claim of close evolutionary relatedness between them. Neither the shared b.84 fold nor visual similarity alone licenses function transfer or use of the other b.84 superfamilies as homologous templates; those claims would require independent sequence, structural-alignment, and phylogenetic evidence. SCOPe links PubMed 19893485 as structural literature for b.84.5, but the hierarchy itself does not establish cross-superfamily homology.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__get_scop_service_info — /api/v1/; /api/v1/releases/current","mcp__scope__search_scop — /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=bulge&mode=auto&limit=50","mcp__scope__get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310577; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310577/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310577/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310577/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51229; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51229/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51229/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310616; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310616/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310616/homology","mcp__scope__list_scop_children — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51229/children?limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310616/children?limit=50"]}]}
